title: CODEX - Poly-l-Lysine Cover-Slip Preparation
author: Leigh Propper
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baxyifpw
materials: Swirl the contents to mix the solution.

steps.title: Select required cover slips
steps.instruction: Remove 12–15 cover‑slips of the specific brand and type required by CODEX from the box.

steps.title: Place cover slips in beaker
steps.instruction: Gently place the cover‑slips into a beaker, spreading them so both surfaces contact the solution, then slowly swirl the beaker to distribute the slips around the base.

steps.title: Add poly‑lysine solution
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL of poly‑L‑lysine solution to the beaker, ensuring all cover‑slips are fully covered.

steps.title: Incubate cover slips
steps.instruction: Cover the beaker with plastic wrap or parafilm, secure tightly with a rubber band to prevent evaporation, and leave at room temperature for a minimum of 12 hours and up to one week.

steps.title: Remove incubation and discard solution
steps.instruction: After the incubation period, carefully remove the rubber band and parafilm, then gradually pour the remaining poly‑lysine solution into the proper waste container.

steps.title: First wash of cover slips
steps.instruction: Fill the same beaker (still containing the cover‑slips) to half volume with double‑distilled water (ddH₂O) or purified water, let sit for 30 seconds (do not soak >1 minute per wash), and slowly pour off the water into the sink (Wash #1).

steps.title: Repeat washes (total seven)
steps.instruction: Repeat the fill‑sit‑pour sequence six additional times for a total of seven washes, each with half‑volume water, 30‑second sit time, and careful decanting.

steps.title: Prepare drying area
steps.instruction: Place two lint‑free Wypall towels on the bench top.

steps.title: Dry cover slips
steps.instruction: Remove the cover‑slips from the water and place them on the first towel without overlapping; using the specialty forceps supplied for CODEX, flip each cover‑slip onto the second clean towel; leave the cover‑slips on the towels to air‑dry completely.

steps.title: Store coated cover slips
steps.instruction: When dry, store the poly‑L‑lysine‑coated cover‑slips in a sterile petri dish or similarly covered container for up to 2 months.

steps.title: Prepare fresh poly‑lysine solution
steps.instruction: Pour enough poly‑L‑lysine solution to cover the bottom of a clean beaker.
